## Upload video, create playlist and add video to playlist

**Purpose**: n8n workflow: Upload video, create playlist and add video to playlist. 6 nodes wired together. Uses: manualTrigger, youTube, readBinaryFile, stopAndError. Sourced from czlonkowski/Zie619 n8n-workflows community archive (workflows/Manual/0476_Manual_Youtube_Create_Triggered.json). Configure credentials and any hardcoded IDs before activating.

**Services needed**: manualTrigger, youTube, readBinaryFile, stopAndError

**Difficulty**: 5min-config

**Setup**:
1. Configure credentials for the services above
2. Update any hardcoded IDs / URLs
3. Test with sample data before activating
